_comment: MERGE the `permission` key into the repo's opencode.json. opencode has no hook process, so the guards become declarative patterns — less expressive (no reason string comes back to the agent), no script to run. Rules are evaluated by pattern and THE LAST MATCH WINS, so these must sit AFTER any broad rule of yours. The gate layer is anchored as `.dev/kit/**` and NOT as a `**/`-prefixed glob on purpose: the kit lives in a DOTTED directory, and a `**/` globstar is not guaranteed to descend into one — the same reason `**/.cargo/mutants.toml` sits next to `**/mutants.toml`. Anchoring removes the question instead of betting on the matcher. There is deliberately no "*" entry here: adding one would silently redefine your default for every other command.
